text:
jamie (People Ops): Quick draft — manager office hours + first-week blueprint for new hires. Please skim and call out gaps. I'm planning a weekly Wed 10–11am slot to answer manager questions.

alex m: Nice! Add 'approve onboarding access requests' as a day-0 item. saves a lot of back-and-forth.

sara (eng manager): Where should I put the 30/60/90 they can edit? Confluence or a doc template?

jamie (People Ops): We'll version the template in Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.com/onboard/manager-templates. I'm pasting the quick checklist below for copy/paste:

```
Day 0 (pre-start):
- Confirm account invites (Slack, Okta, Google Workspace)
- Provision laptop and devbox image
- Open IT/Access tickets (VPN, repo read, infra read-only)
- Add to team calendar + invite to team channel

Week 1 (orientation & access):
- 1:1 with hiring manager (30m daily first 3 days)
- Shadow deploys + infra walkthrough
- Pair with buddy on dev setup
- Security & compliance quickstart
- Define week-1 deliverable (small bug/README)

30/60/90 (outcomes template):
- 30d: onboarded to main codepaths, shipped first small PR, buddy check-in
- 60d: ownership of a routine flow, lead one postmortem or oncall doc
- 90d: measurable improvement (perf/cost/UX), roadmap input, cross-team sync
```

leo (hiring mgr): For 30/60/90 let's make the metrics measurable. e.g. 'deploy cadence: 1 PR/week', 'reduce e2e latency for X by 10%'.

alex m: Also add 'pager walkthrough + runbook read' to week 1 if hiring manager is oncall.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: new-hire checklist created for @new-hires today — automated invite queued.

jamie (People Ops): Great input — I'll update the template and post final link. Planning office hours Wed 10–11am weekly; @sara can you send the invite for next Wed? :thumbsup: 

sara (eng manager): Yep, sent the invite. I'll also add a 30/60/90 review checkpoint at 45 days to catch blockers early.

jamie (People Ops): Love it. Closing loop: final doc will include the editable 30/60/90 template, a manager checklist, and a who-to-ask one-pager (IT, Security, Payroll, Hiring).
